card.name: Into after verbs of placing
card.fires_on: The word "into" (or "in" or "the" right after it) following a verb of putting, pouring or transferring something toward a container or body cavity. Seen in preparation steps, tube feeding and disposal advice.

modes.label: Putting into a container
modes.description: "in" or "into" after putting, transferring or pouring, before a bin, cup or container.
modes.example: Cut them open before putting<< in>> a bin.

modes.label: Delivery into the body or tube
modes.description: "into" after a tube, syringe or solution, before stomach or airway.
modes.example: the nasogastric tube<< into>> the stomach.

modes.label: The after into
modes.description: "the" right after "into" when a mixing container or syringe comes next.

card.writes: It prepares the model to name the destination that comes next, though the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the word "into" when text says to put or pour something into a container, tube or body part.
